_comment: playbook catalog (bundled with the plugin — task-type based, project-agnostic). 1 playbook = 1 task type. Methodology (tdd/bdd/prototype/spec/contract, etc.) is a variant within a task type. A project activates a subset of the bundle via playbooks[] in .flow/settings.json + can derive from it via .flow/playbooks/ overrides. agents/personas are filled in by the project in settings.json (the plugin is project-agnostic). general (the universal fallback) is used by flow-playbook-selection as the fallback when a task matches no task type (replacing a fixed default).

playbooks.refactor: Refactoring — pin behavior with characterization tests, then change incrementally (behavior-preserving)
playbooks.bug: Bug fix — reproduce→failing test→fix→regression (reproduction and regression required regardless of scale)
playbooks.docs: Documentation/spec authoring — gather sources (material)→structure→write→review (includes the requirement/planning spec variant)
playbooks.retro-processing: Retrospective processing — collect retrospectives→recurring patterns→improvements→review→apply (no auto-apply)
playbooks.research: Investigation/research — gather sources→cross-verify (≥2 independent sources)→structure→index/handoff (unlike docs, gathering and verification are the gate)
playbooks.usecase-extraction: Reverse documentation — analyze code/spec→extract use cases→verify two-way code↔doc consistency (direction: code→doc)
playbooks.qa: Quality verification — risk-based allocation of verification→exploratory test charter→defect logging→pass/fail decision
playbooks.security: Security — threat modeling→mitigations (as ACs)→implement→security check→merge (no implementation without a threat model; no merge until the check passes)
playbooks.deploy: Deploy/infra — write runbook and rollback first→plan→review→incremental apply→observe→expand/rollback
playbooks.plugin-dev: Plugin self-development — rule/skill/hook/command changes + full-regression obligation + propagation obligation (rule sync / version bump) + dogfood (a single flow for meta work)
playbooks.general: Universal fallback — when the task type matches no playbook
